questions.question_english:
A Government School in Delhi engages an agency
for gardening. The agency deploys 5 gardeners
for 45 days during the monsoon season. Does
the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition)
Act, 1970 apply to the school as a Principal
Employer for this specific contract?
options_english: Yes, because it is a government establishment and the Act applies universally to all public sector bodies.
Yes, because the routine work of maintaining school grounds and gardening is deemed perennial in nature.
No, because all educational institutions and government schools are completely exempt from the Act.
No, because fewer than 20 workmen are engaged and the seasonal work lasts for less than 60 days.
questions.explanation_english:
No, because the number of workmen is less
than 20 and the work duration is less than 60
days.
The Central Act applies only to establishments
employing twenty or more contract workmen.
Moreover, Section 1(5) exempts intermittent
work, and seasonal work under sixty days is
deemed intermittent. Since the school engaged
only five gardeners for forty-five days, it falls
below the minimum numerical threshold and
meets intermittent criteria, excluding it from
statutory coverage.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत के अनुसार, पाँच माली 20 श्रमिकों की सीमा से कम हैं और 45 दिन की मौसमी तैनाती 60 दिनों से कम है; इसलिए यह उदाहरण अधिनियम के दायरे में नहीं आता।
key_facts: Correct option (English): No, because fewer than 20 workmen are engaged and the seasonal work lasts for less than 60 days.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Principal Employer (PE):
I. The PE in a local authority is the person appointed for the supervision and control of the establishment.
II. The PE is ultimately responsible for ensuring the provision of welfare amenities if the contractor fails.
III. The PE can never be penalized if the contractor fails to pay wages.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english:
I and II only
Statements I and II correctly state that the
Principal Employer in a local authority is the
supervising officer and retains residual legal
liability for welfare amenities under Section 20.
Statement III is incorrect because Section 21(4)
